data.name: Trusted Carbon
data.description: Trusted Carbon is a carbon credit platform focused on nature-based carbon removal solutions including industrial hemp cultivation, afforestation, reforestation, and biochar. The company uses blockchain technology to provide traceability and verification for carbon credits, positioning itself as a marketplace/platform for businesses to purchase verifiable offsets rather than directly operating removal projects.
